description: This file is a shell script used for hardware diagnostics and LED status control within the OpenWrt platform. It includes functions for detecting the diagnostic LED, managing its state during various system states like preinit, failsafe, and upgrade, and interacts with system configuration files and JSON data for its configuration.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Detects the diagnostic LED configuration during system preinitialization by parsing board JSON configuration files and sets the status_led variable if the DIAG LED is configured as default on.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Configures the diagnostic LED status by reading configuration parameters and setting the status_led variable if conditions are met.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the current diagnostic LED status by loading system configuration or falling back to preinit detection.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Sets the LED status based on the system's current state input (preinit, failsafe, upgrade, done) by calling appropriate LED control functions.
